sourceEvidence.title: Principal or Sr. Principal Mechanical Engineer
sourceEvidence.quote:
The successful candidate should have demonstrated experience in hardware design, an understanding of design for manufacturing practices, developing engineering processes, procedures and documentation for manufacturing, and an understanding of engineering's role for supporting small to medium production quantities.
**Basic Qualifications for a Principal Mechanical Engineer:**
• BS degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Aerospace, Ocean Engineering or equivalent STEM) and a minimum of 5 years of experience or MS degree with 3 years of experience or PhD with 1 years of experience.
• Proficiency in using common engineering design, production, analysis, and office tools.
• Ability to work on site at Annapolis, MD campus.
• US citizen with the ability to obtain a TS/SCI and pass a polygraph.
